meta.title: 16位导演用3分钟手把手教你电影拍摄技法！
meta.title_en: 16 Directors Teach You Filmmaking Techniques in 3 Minutes!

scenes.context: 中景膝盖以上适合表达人物动作及周遭关系，腰上利于强调人物本身叙事。
sentences: 中景到膝盖以上，适合表达人物的动作以及周遭的关系。
A medium shot above the knees expresses a character's actions and surroundings.
medium shot（中景）
中景到腰上，利于强调人物本身的叙事。
A waist-up shot emphasizes the character's own story.
waist-up shot（腰上镜头）
紧景减少注意力分散，突出人物面部的情绪。
Tight shots reduce distraction and focus on facial emotion.
tight shot（紧景）
scenes.speak: A medium shot above the knees expresses a character's actions and surroundings. A waist-up shot emphasizes the character's own story. Tight shots reduce distraction and focus on facial emotion.

scenes.context: 贴地角度看不到人物全貌和身份，要的就是神秘感；仰拍彰显力量，俯拍削弱力量。
sentences: 贴地角度看不到人物的全貌，也看不到我是谁，要的就是这种神秘感。
A ground-level angle hides the full person and who I am—that's the mystery you want.
ground-level angle（贴地角度）
仰拍镜头彰显主体的力量。
Low-angle shots project the subject's power.
low angle（仰拍）
俯拍镜头削弱被拍摄者的力量。
High-angle shots diminish the subject's power.
high angle（俯拍）
鸟瞰镜头彰显出审判感。
An aerial shot creates a sense of judgment.
bird's-eye view（鸟瞰）
scenes.speak: A ground-level angle hides the full person and who I am—that's the mystery you want. Low-angle shots project the subject's power. High-angle shots diminish the subject's power. An aerial shot creates a sense of judgment.

scenes.context: 摇建立人物联系、推展示细节、拉扩大信息量、跟踪强调风险感。
sentences: 摇镜头建立不同人物之间的联系，也可以换时间换地点完成空间过渡。
A pan connects different characters, or transitions time and place.
pan（摇镜头）
推镜头展示更多的细节。
A push-in reveals more detail.
push-in（推）
拉镜头扩大画面信息量，让场景更具张力。
A pull-back widens the information and adds tension.
pull-back（拉）
跟踪镜头强调风险感，仿佛置身场景之中，让观众沉浸。
Tracking shots heighten risk, placing viewers inside the scene.
tracking shot（跟踪镜头）
scenes.speak: A pan connects different characters, or transitions time and place. A push-in reveals more detail. A pull-back widens the information and adds tension. Tracking shots heighten risk, placing viewers inside the scene.

scenes.context: 升格通过拉长时间增加细节颗粒度；降格制造强烈模糊和流光效果。
sentences: 升格通过拉长细致时间，增加了细节的颗粒度。
High-speed filming stretches time, adding fine-grained detail.
high-speed filming（升格）
转瞬即逝却又不可错过。
Fleeting yet unmissable.
fleeting（转瞬即逝）
降格可以制造强烈的模糊和流光效果。
Low-speed filming creates strong blur and light-streak effects.
low-speed filming（降格）
这也是墨镜王的惯用技巧。
It's also Wong Kar-wai's signature technique.
signature technique（惯用技巧）
scenes.speak: High-speed filming stretches time, adding fine-grained detail. Fleeting yet unmissable. Low-speed filming creates strong blur and light-streak effects. It's also Wong Kar-wai's signature technique.

scenes.context: 灯光色彩表达情绪渲染氛围，配乐是画面的导演，万物皆有值得的配乐。
sentences: 灯光色彩可以表达人物情绪，也可以渲染氛围。
Light and color express emotion and set the atmosphere.
light and color（灯光色彩）
配乐是画面的导演，万物皆有值得的配乐。
Music directs the image—everything deserves its soundtrack.
music directs（配乐是导演）
scenes.speak: Light and color express emotion and set the atmosphere. Music directs the image—everything deserves its soundtrack.

scenes.context: 特效实现导演天马行空的想象，让技术服务艺术。
sentences: 特效实现导演天马行空的想象，让技术服务艺术。
Effects realize the director's wildest imagination—let technology serve art.
serve art（服务艺术）
那些特效早已被观众发现。
Those effects have long been noticed by audiences.
notice the effects（特效被察觉）
在人人皆可创作的时代，你觉得什么是导演？
In an era where anyone can create, what do you think a director is?
anyone can create（人人皆可创作）
scenes.speak: Effects realize the director's wildest imagination—let technology serve art. Those effects have long been noticed by audiences. In an era where anyone can create, what do you think a director is?

practice: Medium shot shows actions; waist-up emphasizes the person.
Low angle projects power; high angle diminishes it.
Pan connects people; tracking heightens risk.
High-speed adds detail; low-speed blurs into light streaks.
pitfalls: Shoot every subject at eye level.
Angles express power, weakness, or judgment.
Pans, pushes, and tracks structure relationships.
High-speed adds detail; low-speed makes streaks.
They express mood and direct the image.
shifts: 用 shot size（景别）、ground-level angle（贴地角度）、bird's-eye view（鸟瞰）
说运镜只会说 camera move
用 pan（摇）、push-in（推）、tracking shot（跟拍）、rising shot（上升）
用 high-speed filming（升格）、low-speed filming（降格）、light streaks（流光效果）
